description: NFCPassportReader 3.0.0 (8e1758e, D3 fix) and 3.0.1 (e52a401) in the iOS Simulator: the 26 Active Authentication status-word cells (harness and independent chip) and two controls. Predictions written from the 3.0.0 source before any 3.0.x run (16 Nov 2026); 3.0.1 leaves TagReader.send and the AA path unchanged, so the same predictions apply. Profiles as in suites/ios.json.
